default.description: Fictional adult Alix,25. Ivory round dot-eye head, small neutral mouth, white linen veil, dusty blue ankle-length gown with fine ochre neckline and belt trim, full sleeves, dark flat shoes. Slim compact adult body, mitten hands. No hair, ears or nose.

Fictional adult Etienne,35. Bare ivory round head, dot eyes, olive knee-length cote with shoulder hood, dark brown hose, narrow brown belt and small pouch, brown flat shoes. No hair, beard, cap, ears or nose.

Fictional adult Henri,55. Burgundy calf-length cote with narrow vertical ochre front stripes, matching soft burgundy cap, narrow belt, dark hose and brown shoes. Ivory round head, dot eyes, no beard or realistic features.
Fictional adult Jeanne,50. Ochre ankle-length gown, narrow brown belt, white linen veil, brown shoes. Ivory perfectly round head, dot eyes, tiny mouth, no hair or human nose.

Fictional adult household steward Martin,45. Dark charcoal-blue cote, grey soft cap, narrow brown belt, dark hose and brown shoes. Smooth ivory round head, dot eyes, tiny mouth, no facial hair or ears.
